register_tokenizer_mode: register a custom tokenizer mode with its module and class name in the TokenizerRegistry
load_tokenizer_cls: load a tokenizer class by mode from the TokenizerRegistry using resolve_obj_by_qualname
load_tokenizer: load and instantiate a tokenizer by mode from the TokenizerRegistry via from_pretrained
resolve_tokenizer_args: resolve tokenizer arguments handling ModelScope downloads, GGUF paths, and auto tokenizer mode selection
get_tokenizer: get a tokenizer instance for a model name with auto mode resolution and config-based overrides
